text.autoconfig.simplelivemap.title: Simple Livemap
text.autoconfig.simplelivemap.option.gen: Server: records explored chunks and draws the live map. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplelivemap.option.rec: Chunks around a player that count as explored (0 = own chunk, 2 = 5 x 5). Range 0-8. Default: 2.
Ticks between position checks. Range 5-200. Default: 20.
A held filled map adds its drawn area to the explored chunks. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplelivemap.option.ren: How many explored chunks are drawn per server tick. Range 1-32. Default: 2.
A revisited chunk is drawn again when its picture is older (minutes). Range 1-1440. Default: 10.
Brighter and darker pixels by height like Vanilla maps (2.5D look). Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplelivemap.option.web: Built-in read-only web server for the map. Only this computer reaches it (web.bind 127.0.0.1) and it needs the private link; a busy port 8125 moves to the next free one up to 8134. Default: on.
Address the web server listens on; 127.0.0.1 = this machine only. Default: 127.0.0.1.
TCP port of the web server. Range 1-65535. Default: 8125.
private = only with the link and its key; public = everyone who reaches the port. Default: private.
Secret key of the private map, made on first start; /simplelivemap link shows the link. Default: random.
Online players appear with name and position (each can hide with /simplelivemap hide; sneaking, invisible players and spectators never appear). Default: off.
Requests one address may make per minute. Range 30-20000. Default: 1200.
Seconds between updates of the player positions. Range 1-60. Default: 2.
Single player and LAN host: one clickable "Open Livemap" line per session, only to the host. Default: on.
text.autoconfig.simplelivemap.option.hos: Where /simplelivemap connect uploads this world: https only (http only to this machine). Default: https://livemap.simplemods.de.
commands.simplelivemap.status: Simple Livemap: %s explored chunks in %s dimensions, %s waiting to be drawn.
commands.simplelivemap.status.web_lock: Web map server: off - another live map of this installation runs (world %s, port %s). Self-hosting serves exactly one map.
commands.simplelivemap.status.web_port: Web map server: off - another Simple Livemap serves port %s. Self-hosting serves exactly one map.
commands.simplelivemap.status.hosted_off: Hosted map: not connected (/simplelivemap connect <code> with a code from livemap.simplemods.de).
commands.simplelivemap.link.private: Private web map (keep this link secret): %s
commands.simplelivemap.visibility.public: The web map is now public: everyone who reaches the port sees it.
commands.simplelivemap.visibility.privat: The web map is now private: it needs the link with the key.
commands.simplelivemap.hide: Your position no longer shows on the web map.
commands.simplelivemap.show: Your position shows on the web map when the server shows players.
commands.simplelivemap.hint: Simple Livemap: your world as a live map in the browser.
commands.simplelivemap.hint.open.hover: Opens the map of this world in your browser.
commands.simplelivemap.hint.off.hover: Turns this message off (web.chatHint). /simplelivemap link still shows the link.
commands.simplelivemap.hint.on_done: The live map chat hint shows again (once per session).
commands.simplelivemap.hint.off_done: The live map chat hint is off. /simplelivemap link shows the link.
commands.simplelivemap.connect.bad_code: That is no connect code (8 letters and digits from livemap.simplemods.de).
commands.simplelivemap.connect.off: Simple Livemap is off on this server.
commands.simplelivemap.connect.already: This world is already connected (map %s). /simplelivemap disconnect first.
commands.simplelivemap.connect.offline: Could not reach %s (%s). Does the server allow outgoing HTTPS?
commands.simplelivemap.connect.done: Connected! The map is being prepared - progress on livemap.simplemods.de.
commands.simplelivemap.disconnect.none: This world is not connected to livemap.simplemods.de.
commands.simplelivemap.disconnect.done: Disconnected: the map %s moved to the archive on livemap.simplemods.de.
simplelivemap.guide.page.1.title: Simple Livemap
simplelivemap.guide.page.1: A live web map of the world as the players really explored it, with map relief, optional player positions and an optional built-in web server.
simplelivemap.guide.page.2.title: Explored chunks
simplelivemap.guide.page.2: The map only shows what players really explored:
simplelivemap.guide.page.3.title: Explored chunks
simplelivemap.guide.page.3: every chunk a player (not a spectator) walked into, plus record.radius chunks around it (default 2 = 5 x 5), and the drawn area of a filled Vanilla map held in a hand (record.maps, default on).
simplelivemap.guide.page.4.title: Explored chunks
simplelivemap.guide.page.4: Pre-generated or never visited land stays dark, so the map gives away no seed. The server keeps this per player in the world folder (simplelivemap/visited.bin) and saves it every 5 minutes and on stop.
simplelivemap.guide.page.5.title: Map tiles
simplelivemap.guide.page.5: Explored chunks are drawn from above with the Vanilla map colors of their blocks and the Vanilla map relief (higher ground brighter, lower darker, water by depth; render.shading, default on) – the 2.5D look.
simplelivemap.guide.page.6.title: Map tiles
simplelivemap.guide.page.6: Only loaded chunks are read, at most render.chunksPerTick per tick (default 2); a revisited chunk is redrawn after render.refreshMinutes (default 10).
simplelivemap.guide.page.7.title: Map tiles
simplelivemap.guide.page.7: Pictures are 128 x 128 block tiles in five zoom levels under simplelivemap/tiles, written by one background thread. Next to each dimension a height layer (folder <dimension>.h:
simplelivemap.guide.page.8.title: Map tiles
simplelivemap.guide.page.8: height, fluid depth and relief step per block, no picture) feeds the shaded and cartographer map styles of the viewer; areas filled only from map items have no heights there.
simplelivemap.guide.page.9.title: Web map
simplelivemap.guide.page.9: A built-in web server shows the map in the browser (drag, zoom, dimensions). It is on as soon as the mod is installed (web.enabled) but only this computer reaches it:
simplelivemap.guide.page.10.title: Web map
simplelivemap.guide.page.10: it listens on 127.0.0.1:8125 (web.bind, web.port) and the map is private. When port 8125 is busy (a second game, another program), it takes the next free port up to 8134 for this session and says so in the log. It only reads:
simplelivemap.guide.page.11.title: Web map
simplelivemap.guide.page.11: three fixed routes, no file names from outside, a request budget per address (web.requestsPerMinute, default 1200), 4 worker threads; it stops with the server.
simplelivemap.guide.page.12.title: Private or public
simplelivemap.guide.page.12: A map is private by default (web.visibility): the page needs the link from /simplelivemap link,
simplelivemap.guide.page.13.title: Private or public
simplelivemap.guide.page.13: which carries a random key after # (browsers never send that part, so it stays out of logs).
simplelivemap.guide.page.14.title: Private or public
simplelivemap.guide.page.14: /simplelivemap visibility public opens it for everyone who reaches the port. Players only appear with web.showPlayers (default off), with name and position only;
simplelivemap.guide.page.15.title: Private or public
simplelivemap.guide.page.15: everyone can leave the map with /simplelivemap hide and come back with /simplelivemap show.
simplelivemap.guide.page.16.title: Private or public
simplelivemap.guide.page.16: /simplelivemap status shows the counts and the address; status, link and hint also work for the owner of a single-player world without cheats.
simplelivemap.guide.page.17.title: Open Livemap in chat
simplelivemap.guide.page.17: In single player and on a LAN world the host gets one chat line per session with a clickable [Open Livemap].
simplelivemap.guide.page.18.title: Open Livemap in chat
simplelivemap.guide.page.18: It opens the private map in the browser, the key is in the link. Only the host gets it (LAN guests never see the key);
simplelivemap.guide.page.19.title: Open Livemap in chat
simplelivemap.guide.page.19: [Don't show again] or web.chatHint false turns it off, /simplelivemap link still shows the link. Dedicated servers only write a log line.
simplelivemap.guide.page.20.title: Own website
simplelivemap.guide.page.20: You can show the map on your own website: a reverse proxy (nginx or Caddy) in front of the built-in server, or a static copy of the tiles uploaded to any web space.
simplelivemap.guide.page.21.title: Own website
simplelivemap.guide.page.21: The full guide with examples is docs/deploy/LIVEMAP-SELF-HOST.md in the source repository.
simplelivemap.guide.page.22.title: One map per installation
simplelivemap.guide.page.22: Self-hosting serves exactly one live map per installation and server: one web server, one world.
simplelivemap.guide.page.23.title: One map per installation
simplelivemap.guide.page.23: The first world that starts its web map holds a lock (config/simplelivemap-web.lock, released when the game stops, also after a crash);
simplelivemap.guide.page.24.title: One map per installation
simplelivemap.guide.page.24: a second world of the same installation keeps its web map off and says so in the log and in /simplelivemap status. Every answer of the built-in server carries the header X-Simple-Livemap:
simplelivemap.guide.page.25.title: One map per installation
simplelivemap.guide.page.25: when the port is held by another Simple Livemap, this one does not move to the next port (that fallback only skips other programs).
simplelivemap.guide.page.26.title: One map per installation
simplelivemap.guide.page.26: Proxies that merge several worlds are not supported - more maps:
simplelivemap.guide.page.27.title: One map per installation
simplelivemap.guide.page.27: livemap.simplemods.de. Each world gets a random id in simplelivemap/world.json (not from the seed).
simplelivemap.guide.page.28.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.28: Without an own website: make a one-time code on livemap.simplemods.de (valid 15
simplelivemap.guide.page.29.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.29: minutes) and type /simplelivemap connect <code> as game master or single-player owner.
simplelivemap.guide.page.30.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.30: The server then uploads this world's tiles on a background thread - first a list of all tiles with checksums,
simplelivemap.guide.page.31.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.31: then the missing ones as ZIP bundles at the pace the service asks for, afterwards only
simplelivemap.guide.page.32.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.32: redrawn tiles - and live.json in the rhythm of the tier.
simplelivemap.guide.page.33.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.33: Only an outgoing HTTPS connection is needed (hosted.endpoint, default https://livemap.simplemods.de).
simplelivemap.guide.page.34.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.34: The upload key is stored per world in simplelivemap/hosted.json (owner-only file), never in the config, the log or chat.
simplelivemap.guide.page.35.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.35: Players only go up when web.showPlayers is on and the map shows players on the website.
simplelivemap.guide.page.36.title: Hosted map (livemap.simplemods.de)
simplelivemap.guide.page.36: /simplelivemap disconnect moves the map to the archive and forgets the key; /simplelivemap status shows the state.
simplelivemap.guide.page.37.title: Map viewer
simplelivemap.guide.page.37: The same viewer page serves the built-in server and livemap.simplemods.de:
simplelivemap.guide.page.38.title: Map viewer
simplelivemap.guide.page.38: drag and zoom (also with two fingers), dimension list, players on/off and follow a player, jump to coordinates (x z), full screen and a small view settings window (map style, players, coordinates, 512-block region grid, remember the position
simplelivemap.guide.page.39.title: Map viewer
simplelivemap.guide.page.39: - kept in this browser only). Map styles: Blocks (default;
simplelivemap.guide.page.40.title: Map viewer
simplelivemap.guide.page.40: the tile pictures, block edges when zoomed in), Shaded relief (hillshade from the height layer, water darker with depth) and Cartographer (paper map with contour lines every 8 and 32 blocks, inked shores and a compass rose);
simplelivemap.guide.page.41.title: Map viewer
simplelivemap.guide.page.41: without heights the last two use the colors alone. Server settings stay in game (/simplelivemap config); the built-in server stays read-only.
